question: What increase per cubit should be applied up to the nine-cubit range?
premises: A limit up to nine is specified.
An increase of four aṅgulas is prescribed.
The increase is to be made per cubit.
inference: Up to nine, an increase of four aṅgulas per cubit should be made.
uncertainties: The unit of the nine-limit is implied as cubits.
plain_english: Up to nine, an increase of four aṅgulas should be made per cubit.
